name: JAC Japan map 15 km prosperous 1534 start: start-state check, then 50 turns of AI autoplay (OUCHI human) with a survey every 10 turns and the survivors

steps.code: local E={LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE={2,5,4,1,2,2,200},LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE={4,15,8,2,2,13,310},LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO={2,8,6,1,1,7,290},LEADER_JAC_HOJO_UJITSUNA={3,15,8,3,2,12,510},LEADER_JAC_YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI_NORIMASA={5,24,11,4,3,20,540},LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA={2,8,6,1,1,7,230},LEADER_JAC_NAGAO_TAMEKAGE={1,5,6,1,1,4,380},LEADER_JAC_IMAGAWA_UJITERU={3,11,8,2,2,7,410},LEADER_JAC_MATSUDAIRA_KIYOYASU={1,4,4,1,1,3,180},LEADER_JAC_ASAKURA_TAKAKAGE={1,6,6,2,1,4,500},LEADER_JAC_ASHIKAGA_YOSHIHARU={12,31,15,5,4,26,370},LEADER_JAC_MIYOSHI_NAGAYOSHI={4,9,6,1,3,8,160},LEADER_JAC_ROKKAKU_SADAYORI={2,8,7,0,1,8,480},LEADER_JAC_HONGANJI_SHONYO={1,5,4,1,1,2,300},LEADER_JAC_OUCHI_YOSHITAKA={3,15,10,3,2,12,820},LEADER_JAC_AMAGO_TSUNEHISA={1,6,6,2,1,4,400},LEADER_JAC_MORI_MOTONARI={1,3,2,1,1,2,100},LEADER_JAC_CHOSOKABE_KUNICHIKA={1,3,2,1,1,2,100},LEADER_JAC_OTOMO_YOSHIAKI={1,6,7,2,1,4,600},LEADER_JAC_SHIMAZU_TAKAHISA={3,7,5,1,1,6,120},LEADER_JAC_RYUKYU_SHO_SEI={2,7,4,2,2,0,220},LEADER_JAC_AINU_TARIKONA={1,3,2,1,1,2,100}}; local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); local walls=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_WALLS'].Index; local cc=GameInfo.Districts['DISTRICT_CITY_CENTER'].Index; local out={'START'}; local bad={}; local imps={}; for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local pl=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i); if pl:GetImprovementType()>=0 then imps[pl:GetOwner()]=(imps[pl:GetOwner()] or 0)+1 end end; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; local leader=PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName(); local e=E[leader]; if not p or not p:IsAlive() or not e then error('missing player '..i..' '..tostring(leader)) end; local mil={}; local units=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local info=GameInfo.Units[u:GetUnitType()]; if (info.Combat or 0)>0 or (info.RangedCombat or 0)>0 then units=units+1; mil[u:GetY()*w+u:GetX()]=true end end; local cities,pop,wl,gar=0,0,0,0; for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do cities=cities+1; pop=pop+c:GetPopulation(); if c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(walls) then wl=wl+1 end; if mil[c:GetY()*w+c:GetX()] then gar=gar+1 end end; local ds=0; for _,d in p:GetDistricts():Members() do if d:IsComplete() and d:GetType()~=cc then ds=ds+1 end end; local gold=math.floor(p:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()); local got={cities,pop,units,ds,wl,imps[i] or 0,gold}; local names={'cities','pop','units','districts','walls','improvements'}; if gar~=cities then bad[#bad+1]=leader..' ungarrisoned cities '..(cities-gar) end; for k=1,6 do if got[k]~=e[k] then bad[#bad+1]=leader..' '..names[k]..' '..got[k]..' expected '..e[k] end end; if gold<e[7] then bad[#bad+1]=leader..' gold '..gold..' expected >= '..e[7] end; out[#out+1]=leader:gsub('LEADER_JAC_','')..' '..table.concat(got,'/') end; if #bad>0 then error(table.concat(bad,'; ')) end; return table.concat(out,'; ')

local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(); local out={'T'..t}; for i=0,21 do local p=Players[i]; local n=PlayerConfigurations[i]:GetLeaderTypeName():gsub('LEADER_JAC_',''); if p and p:IsAlive() then local pop=0; local cities=0; for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do cities=cities+1; pop=pop+c:GetPopulation() end; local mil=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local info=GameInfo.Units[u:GetUnitType()]; if (info.Combat or 0)>0 or (info.RangedCombat or 0)>0 then mil=mil+1 end end; local tr=p:GetTreasury(); local net=math.floor((tr:GetGoldYield()-tr:GetTotalMaintenance())*10)/10; out[#out+1]=i..':'..n..' c'..cities..' p'..pop..' u'..mil..' g'..math.floor(tr:GetGoldBalance())..' n'..net else out[#out+1]=i..':'..n..' DEAD' end end; return table.concat(out,'; ')
